label: NCAAF

backtest.protocol: rolling by season: hyperparameters fit on all prior seasons, filter updates only from completed games before each game day
backtest.clvNote: archive holds one line per game, so closing-line value is only measurable live through the ledger

variants.description: market margin + ridge(rating - market) fit on earlier games

limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, rest, travel or weather.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
Archived lines are one consensus number per game (effectively closing), so backtest selections are graded at the close and no closing-line value can be measured offline.
The independent model trails the market on margin MAE (13.2187 vs 12.3191); treat it as a sanity check on the market, not a replacement for it.

NCAAF: FCS opponents are pooled into one rating; the betting archive is a multi-book median, carries spread prices only for 2010-2019 (selections after 2019 are graded but unpriced) and ends with the 2025 season; the schedule archive has no future games, so there is no upcoming list.
